newsitem.title: USA: PETROPERU BUYS LOCAL BLOCK 8 CRUDE FOR LATE AUGUST.
newsitem.headline: PETROPERU BUYS LOCAL BLOCK 8 CRUDE FOR LATE AUGUST.

text.p: Peruvian state oil company Petroperu bought around 380,000 barrels of local crude from Block 8 in its latest purchase tender, traders said on Friday.
Petroperu bought the crude at a discount to West Texas Intermediate/Cushing for August 29-31 arrival.
Block 8 is operated by Argentine Pluspetrol, which holds a 60 percent stake in the field. Korean partners Pedco, Yukong and Daiwoo hold the remaining 40 percent.
The crude has an American Petroleum Institute (API) gravity of 25 degrees with a low sulfur content.
The crude is destined for use in Peru's Talara refinery.
Petroperu issued the tender earlier this week, specifying preferred grades from Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador, Mexico and Argentina, as well Peru's own Block 8 grade.
Peru's purchase tenders have become infrequent since last year's sale of the La Pampilla refinery, which is now operated by Spain's Repsol.
